about_the_game: UrbexCAM is a first-person horror exploration game where you and your friends break into eerie, abandoned locations - whether it’s a crumbling house, a shutdown mall, or a forgotten factory - to dig up the dark secrets behind why they were left behind. Each place has its own disturbing story, and it’s up to you to piece together the truth. But you’ll need to be careful - this isn’t just some casual walk in the dark. Try to stay silent and out of sight, because these places are rigged with hidden security cameras, motion sensors, traps, and alarms. One wrong move could alert the cops - or something even worse.
